edits.description: Retained LocalToGlobal through EqualPt in source order, including the intervening port and clip routines. Preserved their original comments.
Retained the original filename, copyright notice, and GRAFASM.TEXT heading. Omitted placeholder fields and later change history. Points.a is a reconstruction filename.
Spelled the two loads of 1 into D2 as MOVEQ and the two loads of 0 as CLR.L. These spellings match the ROM encoding; the later source uses MOVE.L immediates.
Omitted the hasPenFraction block in SetPort. The source history dates this addition to May 1990. The ROM branches to the shared return after setting the port.
Made PC addressing explicit for PortWord, OffsetRgn, RectRgn, and CopyRgn. Replaced IMPORT directives with equates for their verified ROM addresses.
Selected MC68000, copied the required field equates, and added closing directives. These directives add no bytes.
Added marked notes that identify the ROM span, evidence file, source path, and equates.

verification.method: Translate the source syntax, expand its macro definitions, assemble for the 68000, link at the ROM address, and compare every emitted byte.
limitations: Historical MPW assembly has not been tested.
The translator supports the constructs used by the current excerpts.
Byte equality does not establish the exact historical source text or prove completion of the ROM.
